summary: Chiron Real Estate Inc. filed an 8-K/A amending its initial 8-K to include financial statements for two senior housing acquisitions completed June 1, 2026: The Landing Alexandria for $130 million and The Riviera Alexandria for $118.9 million, both in Alexandria, Virginia. The amendment provides audited Statement of Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed for The Riviera, which opened March 2026 with 9% occupancy at Q1 end and 18% at acquisition (23 leased units, avg rent $11,860). Expected yield-on-cost >7% upon stabilization in H2 2028. No advisors or recommendations mentioned. What to watch: lease-up progress and stabilization timeline; risk includes early-stage operations.
